subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk UX should the app target?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new official app and release-signing surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot choose the Apple category, App Store entitlement strategy, or driving-safety product model.

options.title: Keep And Scope CarPlay
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, safety policy, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Mobile RFC
options.body: Move the idea into the mobile RFC process if maintainers want CarPlay evaluated with broader mobile design direction before accepting a platform-specific implementation issue.

options.title: Decline For Now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make this out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Keep And Scope CarPlay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, safety policy, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion explicitly tagged this handle for iOS app product input, and their merged iOS Talk work is the closest existing implementation surface for a voice-first CarPlay path.
